description: A full-stack framework for Laravel that takes the pain out of building dynamic UIs.

latest_release.name: v4.4.10
latest_release.body:
Includes security fixes and reliability improvements. Updating is recommended.

Refresh already-open pages after deploying the update.

hot_issues.title: enum property in component with malformed POST causes wrongful error 500
Island defer loads twice video asset
TypeError: els2 is not iterable thrown in morph keyToMap when a full-page component containing <input> elements re-renders
Overlapping `wire:model.live` requests revert typed input when the value returns to an earlier one
`wire:navigate` cancels mousedown, so a field that saves on blur/change loses the edit when a link is clicked
#[Validate] does not prevent updated() from executing when validation fails
A `#[Url]` value changed in the same request as a `#[Url(history: true)]` value is written onto the previous history entry
Smart wire keys: a conditionally rendered sibling's `wire:key` leaks into a later child component's auto key, remounting the child

discussions.title: Feature Request: Allow Customizing the Base URL Prefix for All Livewire Endpoints in Livewire 4
Better protection against malicious Livewire requests
4.4.8: mixed positional/named event parameters now throw - could the release notes and error message say so?
Let `wire:navigate` react to the response, like `Livewire.interceptRequest` does
`ArraySynth::dehydrate()` writes the dehydrated tuples into the live component property when the array contains a PHP reference
Ferrite: a self-hosted file server built on Livewire 4 and Flux (open source, with a live demo)
Cannot handle file upload without [Livewire\WithFileUploads] trait on the [auth.login] component class.

detail.readme: ## Introduction Livewire is a full-stack framework for Laravel that allows you to build dynamic UI components without leaving PHP. ## Official Documentation You can read the official documentation on the [Livewire website](https://livewire.laravel.com/docs). ## Local Development ```bash git clone git@github.com:livewire/livewire.git && cd livewire composer setup ``` This installs PHP and JS dependencies and sets up ChromeDriver for browser tests. ```bash composer test:unit # unit tests composer test:browser # browser tests (headless) composer test:browser:headed # browser tests (opens Chrome) composer test:browser -- --filter="SupportCSP" # specific tests ``` To build the JS assets after making changes: `npm run build` ## Contributing Thank you for considering contributing to Livewire! You can read the contribution guide [here](.github/CONTRIBUTING.md). ## Code of Conduct In order to ensure that the Laravel community is welcoming to all, please review and abide by Laravel's [Code of Conduct](https://laravel.com/docs/contributions#code-of-conduct). ## Security Vulnerabilities Please review [our security policy](https://github.com/livewire/livewire/security/policy) on how to report security vulnerabilities. ## License Livewire is open-sourced software licensed under the [MIT license](LICENSE.md).
